maya: Quick heads-up — can we re-schedule the weekly cross-func roadmap+triage huddle for this week? Two must-dos: RFC reviews (v2 batching) and the dedicated capacity priority dispute. Need decisions logged.

oliver: I'm OOO Wed afternoon. Can we do Tue 3pm or Thu 9am PT?

sasha: Tue 3pm PT works for me. If we go Thu morning, I'll be on calls for Q3 planning.

ravi: Thu 9am PT ok but prefer async for RFC if we can get pre-reads.

megan: Add design review quickcheck for the UI impact — 10 minutes. I can prep screenshots.

maya: Agenda draft:
- 3m quick intros
- 15m RFC reviews: v2 batching (owners: @oliver, @sasha)
- 10m Priority sync: dedicated capacity commit dispute (owners: @maya, @ravi)
- 10m Design quickcheck (owner: @megan)
- 5m Decision logging + next steps

maya: Pre-reads: <https://docs.redwood.com/rfcs/v2-batching|RFC v2 batching>, and please drop blockers in the thread.

oliver: +1 to Tue 3pm. I'll add a short write-up on perf tradeoffs.

sasha: If we lock Tue 3pm I'll post a short diff summary and link to the PR.

ellie: Calendar-bot: Proposed time sent. Vote 👍/👎 here or accept invite.

calendar-bot: Event: "Crossfunc roadmap+triage" Tue 2025-05-13 15:00 PT — invites sent to participants.

ravi: If anyone can't make Tue, please add async comments on the RFC doc by EOD Monday.

megan: Will upload screenshots and indicate which flows need design signoff.

maya: Quick ownership ask — who will take decision-log notes? we need a canonical entry.

sasha: I can take notes and update the decision-log doc after the meeting.

oliver: FYI — tagging @infra to surface canary status post-RFC: @ellie any objections?

ellie: No objections. I'll post a brief canary checklist during the meeting.

maya: Thanks all. Last call: Tue 3pm PT locked unless major objections. :calendar:

oliver: 👍

ravi: 👍

megan: 👍

sasha: 👍
